[1 media attachment] My little fight against WordPress bots.

My website runs on nginx and static HTML. No WordPress, no plugins, no database.

But automated scanners keep looking for /wp-login.php anyway.
So I gave them a special welcome page:

WordPress: NOT FOUND
wp-admin: NOT FOUND
Database: NOT FOUND
nginx: FOUND

AUTOMATED SCANNER STATUS: CONFUSED 😂

Featuring Kant, Hochkant

Security through actual configuration. Entertainment through German nerd humor.

https://www.dennishilk.com/wp-login.php

#SelfHosting #Linux #Nginx #WebDev #OpenSource #WebSecurity
